verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions e-signature, offer-letter workflows, or per-employee document storage. The only related item is AI-powered compliance support that can 'generate HR documents', which is an adjacent feature: it covers neither sending documents for signature nor storing them per employee. E-signature is a fair axis for an HR and payroll suite, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
